messages:
alexa: Heads-up: customer reported partner key getting charged even though token exchange returned the downstream SA. saw it in billing -> topup.

nate: can you paste a request id? i'll pull traces.

alexa: req=01KLA8T2 show: router attributed at t0, exchange span finished at t0+60ms with subject=sa-team-17, meter shows partner:key-7 billed.

joel: sounds like the router picks a default attribution before the async exchange completes. we do a sync check only for a few paths.

console-team: UX: this will confuse CS. suggest adding "attribution_source" and "effective_identity" columns to request logs. default collapsed and admin-only. also surface "exchange_latency_ms" so we can explain.

sec: +1 on admin-only. audit entries must include attribution_source (fallback|exchange|cache). cannot leak org ids to non-admin roles.

nate: quick mitigation idea: router reads a short-lived exchange-cache (ttl 200ms) and will wait up to 100ms if a pending exchange exists before falling back. feature-flag `auth.attribution.sync_wait` behind rollout.

joel: emit metrics: auth.attribution.waited_count, auth.attribution.fallback_count, auth.attribution.wait_ms histogram. low overhead is critical.

ops-bot: ALERT: high fallback attribution rate for partner:key-7 (42 events / 5m).

console-team: UI plan: add a small admin-only tile that shows recent requests with columns: req_id, timestamp, attributed_entity, effective_identity (collapsed), attribution_source, exchange_latency_ms, trace_link. also add a toggle to show only requests with attribution_source==fallback.

sec: checklist: gate UI behind owner/admin, add audit flag, review storage retention of effective_identity.

alexa: plan: nate will prototype router wait behind flag, joel will add metrics + probe, console-team will implement admin-only columns, sec will review audits. target: probe+metrics in 48h, router opt-in next week, UI in ~2w. i'll file tickets and notify affected customers.

ops-bot: NOTE: oncall acknowledged.
